text_block_list.text:
Starting today, training with Maruzensky
toward her debut race finally begins!
...Or so it was supposed to go.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san, is it true that you're finally kicking things into high gear for your debut!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You've already been dubbed the 'Supercar,'
but how confident are you feeling?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm glad you're paying attention to me,
but starting today, I want to focus on training.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun is getting overwhelmed,
so let's wrap up the interview here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Trainer-chan is getting overwhelmed, so that's all for the interview!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah! At least tell us your thoughts on the upcoming race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Next time, okay! Sowie-sowee!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oho~, the Twinkle Series is about to
get real interesting!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you said it.
...By the way, what does "mengo" mean?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew, I didn't expect to get caught up in an interview out of nowhere.
Causing this much of a stir before your debut is proof enough of your talent.
choice_data_list: That's just how much is expected of you.
That's just how much is expected of you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, in that case, I'll just have to live up to those expectations properly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's assume it's for your debut
and start with a 1200m run."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling all fired up today too,
so I'm sure I'll get a great time♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaa~~h!!
True, her abilities are magnificent, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The wind feels so nice...
Alright, I'm gonna pick up the pace even more~!!

"Above all, the way she looks like she's having fun
while running is her greatest charm...!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, time really does fly by when you're feeling so fulfilled, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer-kun.
Shall we wrap things up soon?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer-chan.
Shall we wrap things up soon?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your hard work in training, Maruzen-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Your running today was so cool too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, my~ Hey there, underclassmen!
Calling me cool makes me so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... if it's all right, please run alongside me next time!
I want to run as fast as you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's my dream to win a Classic race!
So please, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Arima Kinen is my dream too!
So I'll be counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
When it's a request from a sweet junior,
how could I ever say no~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Abso-tootly-lutely! It's an OK!
Let's run together next time!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That's great~!
Though I wonder what "natch" means...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it really feels like youth, doesn't it~?
choice_data_list: Your juniors really look up to you, huh
Your juniors really look up to you, don't they

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, it makes me want to do my best too. I'm truly grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still, to dream of the Classic races and the Grand Prix... huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "...Do you think I should aim for something like that too, after all?"
I believe she's talking about the necessity of defining a clear target—a goal, but...
choice_data_list: I want to aim for a higher stage.
I want to aim for an even higher stage!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...A higher stage?
choice_data_list: Racing on the big stage is supposed to be fun.
Racing on the big stage is supposed to be fun, you know.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Fun...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly...
You really are fascinating, aren't you~?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly...
You really are an interesting one, aren't you~?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Not 'Win that race!' but 'It should be fun'... Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Once I debut, let's keep
challenging big races one after another!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, to celebrate our fresh start,
would you like to go grab some tea now?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I know what 'sweets' are trending right now!
I'll treat you to some!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks delicious, right!
Right now, this is totally all the rage with the hip youngsters—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's nata de coco! Come on, dig in♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's only just started trending,
so not many shops are serving it yet~
choice_data_list: Isn't that just because it's not popular...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're behind the times, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're behind the times, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always chasing the latest trends,
so there's no way I could be wrong!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, just eat up, eat up!
This new texture will bring tears of joy to your eyes~!
And so began our challenge with Maruzensky, whose racing sense was superb, but whose sense of modern trends was questionable!
